document_understanding.document_overview: This Excel document outlines the architecture and workflow of an agentic quality engineering (QE) pipeline. It details the main phases in the pipeline, the roles of different agents, their purposes, and the key outputs produced at each stage.

sheet_summaries.summary: The sheet provides a sequential breakdown of the QE pipeline, mapping each phase to a specific agent role, describing the purpose of each phase, and listing the key outputs. The phases include Ingestion & Parsing, Scenario Planning, Test Authoring, and Publishing.

important_points: The pipeline is divided into four main phases: Ingestion & Parsing, Scenario Planning, Test Authoring, and Publishing.
Each phase is handled by a dedicated agent, ensuring modularity and clarity in responsibilities.
Key outputs at each phase are well-defined, supporting traceability and automation.
document_understanding.final_conclusion: The document provides a clear and structured overview of an agent-driven QE pipeline, emphasizing the division of labor between agents and the expected outputs at each stage. This structure supports scalable and automated quality engineering processes.
